verdict.rationale: Beamer's docs say it integrates with support apps to close the feedback loop, offers a bi-directional HubSpot sync covering the sales/CRM side, and advertises 3,000+ integrations plus API and webhooks. However, the support claim is generic, and no chat tool is named. Missing for 10: named support-tool integrations, any documented chat-tool integration, explicit evidence that captured feedback (comments, NPS, ideas) flows into these tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can connect feedback capture to support, sales, and chat tools I already use

citations.quote: Integrate with your favorite support apps to close the feedback loop.
Now you can connect HubSpot and Beamer better with the new bi-directional sync.
Find 3,000+ available integrations, API and Webhooks
